description:
Get instant pricing for French land-registry documents: mortgage status reports (état hypothécaire), property deed copies, condominium regulations (RDC) and descriptive division statements (EDD).

The app quotes the public price of each service, simulates prices across subscription tiers, and guides you to the right service for your profession — lawyer, bank, credit broker, property manager, real-estate agent or notary. It then provides a direct link to the order page.

Ideal for preparing a real-estate file, verifying a property title or budgeting a mortgage search, without leaving the conversation. French land registry coverage since 1956.

defaultPrompt: Quel est le prix d'un état hypothécaire ?
Quels sont les tarifs d'abonnement Hypothèques en ligne ?
